title: Felt & Fracture
description: A dreamy liquid drum-and-bass-leaning UK dance-pop cut where a rolling Oberheim break threads under warm felt-piano chords. It starts hushed and breathing, slowly blooms layer by layer into a lush rolling groove, drops to a piano-and-air breakdown, then climbs to a shimmering peak before settling back down.

meta.genre: liquid drum and bass / uk dance pop
